flow: Enter actual text, select it with keyboard and apply formatting; assert formatted editor content and serialized output. Exercise requested link/list/save operations; a toolbar alone is insufficient.
grounding: Use actual source data and stable current anchors; new selectors only for required new UI.
Before implementation freeze one continuous browser_check covering the core causal behavior and one important edge; aim for at most 24 actions. Implementation must still satisfy the full instruction.
Use only Harness typed actions, exact expected values derived from source or test input, and end with assert_no_console_errors.
A fixture may arrange preconditions, never write the result being tested. Preserve unrelated routes and interactions.
visual_policy: Prefer deterministic DOM/state/style/geometry evidence; keep a targeted visual check only for explicit requirements those checks cannot establish.
reference_contract: Reference DOM: .wc-editor__toolbar, .wc-editor__content[contenteditable], strong/em/u/s, h1/h2/h3, ul/ol li, blockquote, a[href], img[src].
Use key_press on the editing surface with ControlOrMeta+a. Assert each requested format immediately after applying it. Subsequent block formatting may replace an earlier block type.
Check output contains semantic markup and entered text; do not impose a complete invented nested HTML string. Link assertions use the real sanitized href, not an invented data-testid on the anchor.
Use a same-origin unavailable image URL for an error fixture so browser validation is deterministic and does not depend on external network access.
